name: Redis Cloud
description: Redis Cloud project has Subscriptions, Databases, Cloud Accounts, ACL, and Users CRUD workflows backed by the Redis Cloud Integration Model.

name.description: Optional. New subscription name.

deploymentType.description: Optional. When 'single-region' or not set: Creates a single region subscription. When 'active-active': creates an Active-Active (multi-region) subscription.

paymentMethod.description: Optional. The payment method for the subscription. If set to ‘credit-card’, ‘paymentMethodId’ must be defined. Default: 'credit-card'

memoryStorage.description: Optional. Memory storage preference: either 'ram' or a combination of 'ram-and-flash' (also known as Auto Tiering). Default: 'ram'

persistentStorageEncryptionType.description: Optional. Persistent storage encryption secures data at rest for database persistence. resourceName.description: The resource name of the customer managed key.

region.description: (Required for Active-Active subscriptions only) Region for the customer managed key as defined by the cloud provider.

items.description: Object representing a customer managed key (CMK), along with the region it is associated to.

deletionGracePeriod.description: Optional. The grace period for deleting the subscription if Redis cannot access the provided key. Required when applying customer managed keys for a new subscription.

persistentStorageEncryptionKeys.description: Optional. Contains information about the keys used for each region. Can be used only with external cloud account

cloudProviders.description: Cloud provider, region, and networking details.

cloudAccountId.description: Optional. Cloud account identifier. Default: Redis internal cloud account (Cloud Account ID = 1). Use GET /cloud-accounts to list all available cloud accounts. Note: A subscription on Google Cloud can be created only with Redis internal cloud account.

regions.description: The cloud provider region or list of regions (Active-Active only) and networking details.

items.description: Optional. List the zone ID(s) for your preferred availability zone(s) for the cloud provider and region. If ‘multipleAvailabilityZones’ is set to 'true', you must list three availability zones. Otherwise, list one availability zone.
